EAR.FadeEnabledHint: Tracks fade in when they start and fade out when you stop them — no abrupt cuts
EAR.CrossfadeEnabledHint: When you skip tracks, the old one fades out as the new one fades in — no gap of silence
EAR.NormalizeCleared: Normalization reset — tracks play at their original volumes again
EAR.NormalizeEmpty: Nothing to normalize in this playlist
EAR.TrackIntervalHint: Pause after a track ends, before the next one starts. The fade-in happens after this pause
EAR.HideTrackNamesHint: Players without Observer access see only the channel name (e.g. "Music") instead of the track title — no spoilers from track names
EAR.VolumeTargetHint: A single track, the whole playlist, or all music at once
